dataList.content: It means there are 1,216 customers ahead of you. Be patient, and I'll be right with you. Eventually. 是你们之前还有1216人排队的意思。还能有其他解释吗？只要等下去数字总会慢慢减少的。

Hm... We cannot wait that long. Is there anything we can do to convince you otherwise?
……我们不可能等那么久。还有其他办法吗？

Putty! Big sis! I told you not to glare at customers like that.
油灰姐，我不是让你不要那样盯着客人看吗？

dataList.content:
These ones aren't even that obnoxious. Put your leg down.
这种还不算多难缠的客人，把腿放下吧。

<Ryōshū, can you please stop mulling over where to cut her and help us think of another way to get the dye...?>
<良秀，你也别思考要砍哪里了，还是想想获得染料的方法吧……>

Ryōshū slowly removed her hand from the scabbard. "Putty" followed suit, lowering her pointed leg.
良秀松开刀鞘后，被叫做油灰的人也放下了看上去很尖锐的腿。

*puff* What's there to think about?
呼……有必要烦恼吗？

Let's kill everyone ahead of us in line. There's a shortcut for you.
把排号在我们之前的家伙都砍掉，我们就是第一个了。

The scabbard rattles as though it were shaking its head.
刀鞘像是在摇头一样嗡嗡作响。

... You're clearly looking for an excuse to start a bloodbath, as always. Why else would you suggest a massacre like that when it would be more efficient to kill whoever's first in line and take their numbered ticket?
……真是饱含私欲的建议啊。按你的说法，直接砍了排第一的人，抢走他的排号不就好了？

Heh. There's aesthetics to be enjoyed in irrationality.
呵。这正是不合理的美学。

... Or just buy the dye from whoever's first in line...?

Naked of Le Noir. One of the people who came down early and camped out before opening.

We're almost done filling up a bucket of dye with the Golden Pus dripping from the Golden Resin. He's probably waiting in the corridor to pick it up.

Under current operational conditions, purchasing the Golden Dye from this... "Naked" individual should be the most efficient course of action.
目前看来，从那人手中购入黄金染料是最好的方法。

<I don't think the eyeballs we have will come anywhere close...>
<只不过以我们手头的眼球数量，怎么看都不够吧……>

Should our funds prove insufficient, an item of commensurate value may be offered in exchange.

<……检查一下我们现在有什么吧。>

Meursault laid out, one by one, every item we have purchased or obtained thus far.
默尔索逐个拿出了我们目前为止购入的所有物品。

... A considerable assortment.
……种类还挺多的。

Would selling all of this cover the cost of the Golden Dye?
把这些都卖了能买到黄金染料吗？

dataList.content:
Not even close. Maybe if you found a real sucker and fleeced them for every last eyeball.
完全不够吧。除非能把它们全都以天价卖出去。

<That's a problem... Should we go back to 3F and ask for more eyeballs?>
<这下麻烦了……要回到3F多要些眼球吗。>

It is unlikely they'll be willing to make another significant expenditure when they've already given us quite the stipend.
我们已经得到了资金援助。毫无成果就要求增加援助金额应该会很困难吧。

However, if that is your wish, Executive Manager, I, Outis, shall deploy the peerless negotiation techniques I have sharpened through years of service and field-requisition every last eyeball they possess.
当然，如果执行经理您需要，我奥提斯。一定会用磨练出的交涉技巧将他们手中的眼球全部收入囊中给您看。

<Th-that won't be necessary. Naked is a member of Le Noir... Maybe he'll lower the price if we show him the Authenticity Certificate.>
<不，不用了……既然那个叫做裸体的人也属于黑派……只要给他看鉴定报告，或许能稍微讲讲价吧。>

<Let's find Naked and hear what he has to say. If he's Le Noir, his clothes should make him easy to spot.>
<先去和他聊聊看好了。既然是黑派的成员……那打扮一定很显眼。>
